content:
Today's macOS Tahoe 26.7 candidate build contains a short video that appears to show Apple's rumored camera-equipped AirPods in action. Check out the clip below.

macOS 26.7 includes demo of camera-equipped AirPods

MacRumors discovered a video in today's macOS Tahoe 26.7 RC featuring a man wearing AirPods who appears to ask Siri to remember the book he is reading. The Siri voiceover reads as follows:

The camera itself is not visible in the clip, and the earbuds look very similar to the current AirPods Pro. The most obvious difference is the stem, which appears to be slightly thicker.

Aaron Perris has also posted the same video to X:

Bloomberg's Mark Gurman previously reported that Apple could launch AirPods with cameras as early as this year, with the internal codename B790. Earlier, MacRumors also found references to B790 in the macOS 26.7 RC, including the string "image stream".

Interestingly, these AirPods are reportedly separate from another camera-equipped model with the internal codename B798 that Bloomberg says Apple has been developing, which is not expected to launch until 2027.

Given that Apple chose to hide this demo clip inside the macOS 26.7 RC, there's a good chance these camera-equipped AirPods will be officially unveiled at next month's iPhone event.

What do you think of the video? Let us know in the comments.
